content:
sophie: Morning — quiet cut window today. Quick status: merge queue ~24 PRs; 3 blocked by failing e2e, 1 blocked on infra backport. I'll list owners and short asks.

kevin: Can confirm canary #458 showed a mem spike at 02:13. I rolled it back to keep the lane green.
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/release-canary-458
```

aisha: I'll triage the e2e flakes. Running `make test-e2e --focus=integration` locally and opening a test-run log in the flaky-e2e issue: https://github.com/redwood-inc/repo/issues/99

build-bot: CI started for PR #412 — https://ci.redwood/internal/pipelines/412 (build queued)

jonah: Heads-up: PR #399 needs a rebase vs main. @maria can you rebase or I can do a quick fix? small conflict in api/protos.

maria: On it, rebasing now. ETA ~30m.

sara: Backport for 1.2.3 is blocked: infra service account perms missing (INF-842). Raised ticket and added steps we need from infra.

ops-bot: INF-842 status changed: awaiting approval from cloud-admin group. https://infra.redwood/tickets/INF-842

kevin: If perms don't land by noon we should plan a focused hotfix deploy for the affected customer instead of waiting on the backport. Stage smoke checkout passed earlier.

deploy-bot: Deploy requested: hotfix-1.2.3 -> staging. Status: queued (requestor kevin).

sophie: Today: help get e2e green, watch canaries, and finalize the hotfix playbook doc. Blockers: INF-842 and the flaky nightly job that is producing noise in CI.

jonah: I'll review #421 and #425 this afternoon and try to clear merges before 18:00 PT.

maria: rebased and pushed. pinged CI — https://ci.redwood/internal/pipelines/412/results

sophie: thanks — please add a short note to the merge (why the rebase) so reviewers know it's safe to merge.

jonah: ack. I'll add the note and do a fast review after lunch.

sara: tagging @ops-team to expedite INF-842 if possible :pray:

kevin: if anyone needs me to cut the hotfix branch manually I can do that once we decide.

sophie: OK — let's regroup in this thread if anything changes. Otherwise we'll run the hotfix path only if INF-842 is unresolved by 12:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
